summary: rustypaste is a lightweight file upload and pastebin service written in Rust. It provides a straightforward backend for hosting your own text snippets and binary files. The project is distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits developers who want a minimal, self-hosted endpoint for sharing code snippets or logs without the bloat of larger platforms.
watchOut: As a minimalist utility, it lacks advanced features like user management or complex access control out of the box, meaning you will need to handle authentication and rate limiting externally.
deployNotes: Being a compiled Rust binary, it typically runs as a standalone service behind a reverse proxy like Nginx or Caddy to handle TLS and domain routing, alongside persistent storage for uploaded files.
